result.brief: 提出潜空间动力学推理（LDR），将潜状态转移建模为显式运动学积分，仅回归高阶残差，实现视频世界模型对学习动力学的分布外外推。
result.reason: Introduces Latent Dynamics Reasoning for video world models, explicitly modeling latent transitions as kinematic integration to extrapolate learned dynamics beyond training distribution, validated on physics benchmark.
